content:
TEMPTATION ||| Grip the Answer tighter, leaning into the tension ||| "Let them see how I stand, unyielding."  
BOUNDARY ||| Shift my weight, drawing a line in the air ||| "I refuse to answer until the truth is clear."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, revealing my uncertainty ||| "I feel lost, and I can't pretend otherwise."  
REVERSAL ||| Step forward, claiming my voice in this space ||| "I'll speak when I'm ready, and not before."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, letting the moment stretch ||| *A slow breath.*
